hints.title: Doubly Linked List Sentinel Pointers
hints.text: Anchor a bidirectional chain with pseudo head and tail sentinels to eliminate special-case boundary handling.

hints.title: Indexed Traversal and Insertion
hints.text: Maintain size counter. Traverse from head or tail depending on index proximity. Link new node between predecessor and successor.

hints.title: Doubly Linked List Blueprint
hints.text: In init: head and tail sentinels with head.next = tail, tail.prev = head, size = 0. addAtIndex(index, val): if index in range, find pred and succ, splice new node, size += 1. deleteAtIndex(index): unlink node at index, size -= 1.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(index) for get/insert/delete, O(1) for head/tail
variables: N: number of elements in linked list
complexity.notes: Sentinel nodes ensure clean edge case insertions and deletions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Singly linked lists require traversing from the start to find predecessor on tail operations and deletions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Doubly linked pointers double pointer memory while enabling bidirectional navigation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of dummy sentinel nodes to eliminate null checks for empty lists and single-node edge cases.
